# Data Directory

This directory contains the raw and processed data for the Financial Analytics & Compliance Agent.

## Raw Data (Not included in Git)
- `bank_transactions.csv`: Download this from the [Kaggle Bank Transaction Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/thuandao/bank-transactions-dataset-for-fraud-detection) and place it here.
- `policies/`: Place your Anti-Fraud PDF documents in this subfolder.

## Processed Data (Generated by ingestion scripts)
- `finance_bank.db`: SQLite database generated by `ingestion/sqlite_setup.py`.
- `chroma_db/`: Vector store generated by `ingestion/vector_store.py`.
